title: Lane Stop hook checks the lane worktree, not the lead cwd
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15: S26 lane (krn-lane subagent) reported its Stop hook evaluated the lead worktree .krn/worktrees/plan-at-start after the lead cd-ed into it, not the lane worktree adopted-gates-run.
Outcome: the Stop hook for a subagent resolves the worktree from the lane session (its claim or last edited path), not the shared session cwd.
Proof: test feeds a SubagentStop payload with cwd of another worktree and a lane claim; the hook checks the claimed worktree.
